violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: CAN OPENER
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. CFM dissemble can opener and proceed to wash, rinse and sanitize.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: Observed Whipped light cream in cold well at 46F
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CFM discarded Whipped light cream from cold well

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter. Observed wet wiping cloths on counter
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. CFM prepare QUAT sanitizer at 300ppm and store wiping clothes on sanitizer bucket.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: caramel ice cream (44F), strawberry ice cream (55F) in machines; Dannon YoCream soft serve mix (44F) and YoCream frozen yogurt mix (44F) in #2.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM discarded the ice cream mixes and cleaned out the frozen yogurt machines, during the inspection for compliance.

out_items.name: Adequate ventilation and lighting, designated areas used

violations.title: Designated Storage for Clothing, Possessions
violations.observation: Observed the 2 DR UR out of commission refrigeration unit is being used to store personal items, dry foods, and single service items all inside. Observed employee clothing and other possessions stored in areas that may contaminate food, food-contact surfaces of equipment, single-service items, or single-use items.
violations.corrective_action: EHS educated the CFM to remove personal items and belongings from the refrigerator and store in a separate space. Instruct employees to use a designated space, away from food prep, to prevent contamination of food, food equipment and utensils, and preparation surfaces.

violations.title: Limited Food Manager - Issued by Health Department
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment which has only non-TCS foods and/or minimally prepares or handles Ready-to-Eat (RTE) food unless it is under the immediate control of a limited certified food manager.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a limited certified food managers certificate.
